literal: The learning of those who have learned and understood will shine in the presence of those who are capable of analyzing words flawlessly.
translation: The learning of those who have studied and understood will shine brilliantly when presented before those who are experts in analyzing words flawlessly.
modern: நூல்களைக் கற்று அவற்றின் பொருளை உணர்ந்தவர்களுடைய கல்வியானது, சொற்களைக் குற்றமற ஆராய்ந்து அறியும் வல்லமை உடையவர்களின் அவையின்கண் விளங்கித் தோன்றும்.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes the importance of the audience when expressing one's knowledge. The learning of a scholar only finds its true value and shines brightly when it is presented before an audience of experts who can flawlessly analyze and appreciate the nuances of language and argument. Speaking before those who cannot evaluate words is futile; it is the discerning assembly of critics and scholars that brings out the true luster of one's education. The key terms 'சொல்தெரிதல் வல்லார்' (those capable of analyzing words) and 'கசடற' (flawlessly) highlight that only a highly competent audience can truly validate and elevate a speaker's knowledge.
